coach_interpretation.verdict: The aerobic execution was controlled, and the light pre-session meal was adequate. HR had short smooth excursions but no meaningful settled drift; the higher-than-predicted Garmin load requires next-day review rather than being interpreted as strain by itself. Contact-point fit passed provisionally, while the minute-40 leg fade means duration tolerance at the final 12 mm-aft saddle position is not yet proven.
coach_interpretation.nutrition: The pre-session intake likely supplied approximately 20-40 g carbohydrate and at least 24 g protein. No during-session carbohydrate was required for this 45-minute easy dose.
coach_interpretation.fit_interpretation: The saddle stayed fixed, foot position was stable, hand pressure was 3/10 overall, and there was no rocking, scooting or symptom response. Retain the 12 mm-aft position provisionally without further adjustment. The late leg fade may reflect first sustained exposure to the new effective reach or other recovery context; it is not explained by cardiovascular drift.
coach_interpretation.thursday_constraint: Thursday MTB is neither cleared nor cancelled by this result, but the late leg fade earns no upgrade. Fresh Thursday sleep/readiness/CNS evidence plus normal legs and no fit symptoms remain required.
